evidence.title: Supa Fonts - Library of fonts & font generators

name: Supa Fonts
summary: Free font library with per-font downloads and generator pages for previewing text in each font.
description: A free font library organised into categories such as display, elegant, groovy, sans serif, serif, sports, handwriting, western and typewriter. Each font page gives a description, designer and licence note (often "free for commercial use") plus a download and a generator for previewing custom text with selectable size, background and color.
contains: font categories incl. display, elegant, groovy, sports, western, medieval, stencil
per-font page with description, designer and licence note
font generator: preview custom text with size, background and color
